caption.text:
Love is not supposed to feel like guessing.  The right kind of connection brings a sense of ease — not because everything is perfect, but because you feel safe enough to be understood, even in the moments when you don’t fully understand yourself. 

You deserve someone who chooses curiosity over assumption, softness over reaction, and presence over distance. Someone who doesn’t just love you when it’s easy, but leans in closer when it’s not. 

The kind of love meant for you will not make you feel like you have to explain your worth or translate your feelings. It will meet you where you are, and remind you that being deeply seen is not too much — it’s exactly what you were meant to experience. 

— Words from the book ‘And Yet — Here You Are’ by Eileen Lamb 🖤📖
